messages.author: 3b718630a63ab359
messages.subject: updateSelectInput not working for select input in another panel
parts:
I tried to insert an item to several dropdown select input in two different tabs. The ones on the current active tab would change (have the newly inserted item), but the ones on another tab would not. But if I click the add button again, the unchanged ones will now have the newly added items. Is there a way to fix this?

Thanks!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: updateSelectInput not working for select input in another panel
parts: I believe this code can be dramatically simplified, but since I am leaving for useR soon I don't have time to explain. In the meantime I think an easy fix is to set outputOptions(session, xxx, suspendWhenHidden=FALSE) for each of your renderUI outputs. I think the problem is that those select inputs don't actually exist at the time that you try to update them (note that outputs, including renderUI outputs, don't run if they're not visible).
